summary: Rev 3 + Visit Insights tested end to end on the preview. Backend: 48/48 unit tests pass; new integration suite tests/test_rev3_api.py 22/22 pass (layout/title/footer/cookie, distance + km cookie + invalid fallback, Near me Toronto via XFF 174.114.163.181 -> 'Courses near Toronto', non-CA IP -> notice-near_failed, program filter, .ics (3 VEVENTs) + Google link + share, shared advanced course opens tab with details[open] + og:title, course_missing notice, reminder 400 bad email, real reminder to delivered@resend.dev -> pending -> confirm redirect + notice -> cron 401 wrong bearer / 200 accepted -> doc deleted + 'Sent 1 course reminder(s)' in log, cancel -> notice-reminder_cancelled / reminder_invalid, insights beacon + admin API (city/days), 401 anon / 403 member, unknown host 404, healthz). Frontend (Playwright): all requested flows work: header/title, cookie notice OK persists over reload, distance 200 auto-submit + persists, Near me fallback, program filter + tab reset, card actions (Register, ics download, Google, Share -> 'Link copied' + clipboard URL), remind form UI ('Check your inbox...' and invalid email message), shared links, French labels/titles ('Art de vivre - Partie 1', 'Art de vivre Ottawa'), /privacy /terms EN+FR, admin dashboard admin-menu-insights, /admin/insights tab views + courses table + city/days selects, other admin pages load, My dashboard link, refresh keeps session, member sees no admin menu and 'You do not have access'. One bug found and fixed: legal pages rendered every section body inside the <h2> (bold, large).

minor.issue:
FIXED by tester: locale bodies use '## Heading\nBody' in one block, so the whole block (heading + paragraph) was wrapped in

; now the first line is the h2 and the rest a

.

Unauthenticated, no rate limit, and accepts any courseId in the feed even if outside the city's area -> insights can be inflated/polluted. Also titles always recorded from the EN feed (fine) and tab_view recorded on every / and /api/home-content hit including bots.
State-changing GET: email link scanners/prefetchers can auto-confirm. Consider a confirm page with a POST button or accept the risk.

ui_bugs.issue: When the IP can't be located the toggle stays 'on' (aria-pressed=true, label 'Near Ottawa instead') although results are already Ottawa, and the near_failed notice repeats on every page in the session (near cookie=1). Consider not persisting near=1 when lookup fails.
Error messages ('Please enter a valid email address.', 429/503) are shown in the same green success colour (.cs-status #065F46).

issues: Program filter option names stay English ('Art of Living Part 1 (4)') while course titles are French ('Art de vivre - Partie 1').
Footer not pinned to the bottom on short pages: a grey band shows below the white footer.
'You do not have access to this page.' is flush to the left edge instead of inside the page container.
Auto-submit adds an empty '&program=' to URLs (cosmetic).
No loading indicator while data loads/changes; tabs with 0 views (e.g. online) are omitted rather than shown as 0.

Near me failure: don't keep near=1 / pressed state when the IP can't be located
Use an error colour for remind-form error messages
Optionally translate program names in the FR program filter
Minor SPA layout: sticky footer (min-h-screen flex column), container for the no-access message
critical_code_review_comments: insights.course_event: no auth/rate limit, no check that the course belongs to the city's area.
reminders.confirm_reminder: GET mutates; no check that the course is still upcoming (cron cleans it later, OK).
home_view: near cookie persists even after a failed lookup, causing repeated fallback notices.
Insights.jsx: no loading state; errors handled.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (minor UX/design issues only)

seed_data_creation: No seed data. Sent 2 real reminder emails to delivered@resend.dev (one consumed by the cron test and deleted, one from the UI deleted by id afterwards). A TEST_tok_ reminder doc was inserted and removed by the cancel endpoint. insight_events / access_logs got test traffic (tab views, course_open, share, calendar_add, reminder_signup for courses 1731160, 1670399, 1673840) - not deleted (TTL 90 days).
